reviewPolicy: No provisional screenshot value is promoted to live site data without visual review, mapping provenance, and focused tests.
knownGaps: No new values are promoted into live data.
DMR records remain provisional until title, subtype, cost, description, and full displayed stat panel are visually reviewed.
Sight/optic coverage is absent unless shown by the overview; absence is not treated as not available.

GRT-CPS baseline context: The attempted Basic Barrel + Standard Ammo baseline was not capturable because Standard Ammo is not unlocked on GRT-CPS. The supplied screenshots therefore show the default Hollow Point ammo equipped. Displayed baseline is 1.50x headshot multiplier and 0.67x collateral multiplier; preserve screenshot arrows and compare provisionally against this Hollow Point baseline.
